Material and neutral captures show matching major terrain silhouettes. No wide central fissure is visually apparent; numerical seam measurements remain separate evidence.
Elongated sharp cliff ribs occur in both neutral UE and the source Houdini render; they were not hidden by material tuning.
Scree closeup frames a source-authenticated occurrence with mixed surrounding classes, not a large pure Scree patch.
Dark flat foreground in PBR is visible as a continuous surface in neutral; screenshots alone do not establish source validity or collision.
Native main-material tessellation is disabled and Landscape Nanite is disabled on all four actors. Neutral masked material has a directly observed LandscapeVisibilityMask connection.
